name: Oyster HR
headline: Global Workforce Compliance
summary: Oyster helps organisations build international teams without the usual admin burden, high risks, or lengthy setup requirements.
body: Oyster is a global employment platform built for distributed teams. Through Bradford Jacobs you get independent advice on when Oyster fits — and when another model or provider is a better match — plus preferred commercial terms across the network.

facts.label: Countries
facts.detail: One of the widest EOR footprints for remote and distributed teams.

facts.label: Hiring model
facts.detail: Known for getting compliant hires live without standing up local companies.

facts.label: Rollouts
facts.detail: Strong when you need several countries online in one programme, not one-off pilots.

strengths: Broad country coverage for remote and distributed hiring
Simplified employment workflows with clear compliance guardrails
Strong fit for growing teams expanding into many markets at once
bestFor: Companies that want to hire quickly across many countries without standing up local entities.

reviews.author: Ops lead, SaaS
reviews.quote: We hired in six countries in one quarter without opening entities. Onboarding was predictable.

reviews.author: People partner, fintech
reviews.quote: Compliance guardrails are clear. Support is better when you have a broker in the middle for pricing.

reviews.author: Founder, remote-first
reviews.quote: Best fit for multi-market hiring when you do not want local companies yet.

name: TopSource Worldwide
headline: Enterprise-Grade PEO
summary: Specialises in complex multi-country deployments with dedicated account management and custom compliance support.
body: TopSource Worldwide focuses on enterprise-grade PEO and multi-country programmes. Bradford Jacobs helps you compare TopSource against other PEO and EOR options so the model matches your headcount, risk profile, and support needs.

facts.label: Core strength
facts.detail: Known for co-employment and PEO structures that standard EOR products do not cover well.

facts.label: Account teams
facts.detail: Named support for complex, multi-country programmes — not a ticket-only model.

facts.label: Compliance
facts.detail: Often chosen when policy, works councils, or local quirks need hands-on design.

strengths: Built for complex, multi-country enterprise deployments
Dedicated account management and custom compliance support
Strong operational depth where standard EOR playbooks fall short
bestFor: Enterprise teams running complex multi-country programmes that need dedicated support.

reviews.author: HR director, enterprise
reviews.quote: Handled a messy multi-country PEO rollout where a standard EOR product was not enough.

reviews.author: Global mobility manager
reviews.quote: Dedicated account team matters. Escalations actually move.

reviews.author: CFO, industrial
reviews.quote: Custom compliance work took longer than a SaaS EOR — worth it for our works-council markets.

name: Deel
headline: Global Payroll & Compliance
summary: Global Payroll and EOR solutions with 150+ country coverage, automated compliance and same-day onboarding.
body: Deel combines EOR and global payroll with a product-led experience and broad coverage. As an independent broker, Bradford Jacobs maps Deel against alternatives on cost, coverage depth, and operational fit for your markets.

facts.label: Countries
facts.detail: Broad EOR and payroll coverage with a modern, product-led experience.

facts.label: Onboarding speed
facts.detail: Known for fast paths from signed offer to compliant start in many markets.

facts.label: EOR + payroll
facts.detail: Strong when you want one stack for employment and multi-country payroll ops.

strengths: Wide EOR and payroll coverage with a modern product experience
Automated compliance workflows and fast onboarding paths
Useful when speed-to-hire and self-serve tooling matter
bestFor: Teams that want fast onboarding and unified payroll/EOR tooling across many markets.

reviews.author: Head of talent, scale-up
reviews.quote: Same-week starts in several markets. Product is fast when the model fits.

reviews.author: Finance ops
reviews.quote: Payroll + EOR in one place helps. We still needed broker pricing vs list rates.

reviews.author: COO, marketplace
reviews.quote: Self-serve tooling is the reason we shortlisted them for speed-to-hire.

name: Lano
headline: Global Payroll & Workforce Operations
summary: Consolidated global payroll operations with a focus on multi-currency reporting and clear operational visibility.
body: Lano centres on consolidated global payroll and workforce operations. Bradford Jacobs helps finance and HR leaders compare Lano’s consolidation strengths with other payroll and EOR partners in the network.

facts.label: Payroll markets
facts.detail: Known for consolidating multi-country payroll into one operational view.

facts.label: Reporting
facts.detail: Strong multi-currency reporting for finance teams that need clean cross-border visibility.

facts.label: Workforce admin
facts.detail: Chosen when payroll consolidation matters more than a full EOR platform story.

strengths: Good fit when payroll consolidation is the primary need
bestFor: Finance and HR teams consolidating multi-currency payroll across many countries.

reviews.author: Group controller
reviews.quote: Finally one view of multi-currency payroll across regions.

reviews.author: HRIS owner

reviews.author: VP Finance

name: Parakar
headline: Europe-Focused EOR
summary: Europe-wide EOR with in-country HR specialists, giving compliance depth across the EU and immigration support.
body: Parakar is Europe-focused EOR with in-country specialists and immigration support. Bradford Jacobs positions Parakar where European depth matters more than a one-size global platform.

facts.label: Market focus
facts.detail: Known for European EOR depth rather than thin global coverage.

facts.label: In-country specialists
facts.detail: Hands-on local HR support that global platforms often cannot match in Europe.

facts.label: Hire support
facts.detail: Often used when visas and mobility sit alongside the employment model.

strengths: Deep European EOR coverage with local HR specialists
Immigration and compliance support across the EU
Strong alternative when Europe-only depth beats global breadth
bestFor: Companies hiring primarily across Europe who need local HR and immigration expertise.

reviews.author: EU expansion lead
reviews.quote: In-country HR in Europe felt night-and-day vs a thin global EOR.

reviews.author: People ops, DACH
reviews.quote: Immigration alongside employment was handled without juggling three vendors.

reviews.author: Founder, EU SaaS
reviews.quote: If you hire mostly in Europe, depth beats another 100-country logo.
